purpose: Teach: 悗/薀/ワット/塁/モル/代打/士官/コミンテルン

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、古文書の悗、つまり「悗」字の解読を、警察、専門家に依頼されますね
lines.en: So with this case, you'll be asking the police and specialists to help decode those old documents, right?
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful pace. Slight upward inflection on the question. Respectful tone—not challenging, genuinely curious. Lean forward slightly with interest.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の薀蓄、つまり薀の知識自慢を、警察、観察されますね
lines.en: Yes, we're carefully observing what the suspect knows and claims to know—their background, their expertise. That helps us understand their angle.
lines.style: Professional and steady. Clear enunciation. Not rushed. Collaborative warmth underneath the official tone. Brief pause after 'observing' to show measured consideration.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、消費電力ワットの異常値を、警察、鑑識されますね
lines.en: And the power consumption readings in this case—the anomalies—I assume the forensics team will be analyzing those?
lines.style: Same reflective tone as before. Slightly faster than the previous line—building on the conversation. Genuine question, not performance. Slight lean-back.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、野球場の塁、つまり塁周辺の事件にも対応されますね
lines.en: Absolutely. We're also covering the wider scope—incidents around the perimeter of the area, anything that might connect. We have to cast a broader net.
lines.style: Confident and assured. Slightly firmer than the previous response. Shows competence without swagger. Natural, unhurried delivery. Nod imperceptibly mid-sentence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、薬物のモル、つまりモル濃度を、警察、分析されますね
lines.en: So the drug concentration levels you mentioned—those will be getting a full chemical analysis, correct?
lines.style: Return to the reflective tempo. Calm, methodical. Genuine verification—he's checking his understanding. Slight tilt of head. End on a gentle rise.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の代打、つまり代理担当を、警察、配置されますね
lines.en: We are. We've also assigned a lead investigator to take point on this—coordinating across all the analysis teams to make sure nothing falls through.
lines.style: Clear, direct, professional. Reassuring without being patronizing. Warm undertone beneath the formal language. Shows competence and organization.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、退役士官、つまり元将校への聞き取りを、警察、丁寧におこなわれますね
lines.en: Right. And I assume you're also conducting careful interviews with the retired military officers involved? Getting their firsthand accounts?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Respectful of the gravity of that line of inquiry. Slight pause before 'retired'—shows he's being precise. Genuine verification, not doubt.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、コミンテルン関連の歴史史料も、警察、参照されますね
lines.en: We are. We're also reviewing the historical records—anything related to the Comintern period that might give us context. Every thread matters here.
lines.style: Measured authority. Slight intimacy—he's bringing Ren into the investigative circle. Thoughtful pace. Weight on 'historical records' and 'every thread.' Calm conviction.
